name: profile-derived-v1
purpose: Derive Emerald gameplay parameters from official Japanese encyclopedia evidence while keeping official source fields separate from project gameplay interpretations.
evidence_inputs: official Digimon type / Appmon app type
official special-move names and descriptions when available
official form/mode wording and explicitly stated relationships

stats.rule: Score every stat independently from the entity's official evidence. No required total, tier total, normalization target, or cross-species cap.

battle_type.rule: Infer Emerald battle type(s) from the whole official evidence set. Never map a Digimon type label or Appmon category mechanically to a Pokemon type by itself.
battle_type.material_evidence_policy: Generic metal, super-metal, Chrome Digizoid, Red Digizoid, weapon, claw, shield, Digimental, or equipment mentions are not strong Steel evidence by themselves. Explicit body-integrated or whole-body structural metal wording contributes strong Steel evidence and may support a secondary Steel affinity alongside a stronger elemental affinity.
battle_type.official_type_secondary_policy: An official type label contributes only the affinities explicitly encoded for that label. Secondary affinities such as Fighting must come independently from profile or move evidence; 暗黒騎士型 does not grant Fighting by taxonomy alone.
battle_type.strong_profile_behavior_policy: Explicit official Japanese profile wording that directly describes an elemental attack, elemental emission, sustained flight, or equivalent battle-relevant behavior can clear the resolution threshold without lowering the threshold itself. Habitat or appearance-only wording remains insufficient by itself.
battle_type.normal_type_policy: TYPE_NORMAL is reserved as the unresolved runtime placeholder in profile-derived-v1. Generic taxonomy or prose such as 獣型, 哺乳類, 突然変異, 一般, 日常, or 生活 must not resolve or supply a secondary Normal affinity. A future resolved Normal mapping requires separate explicit semantic evidence and review.
battle_type.lexical_false_positive_policy: Battle-type scoring masks exact Japanese clauses whose matching token describes another Digimon, a comparison/resemblance, a habitat/target noun, a negated property, or a lexical compound rather than the subject's own affinity. Exclusions are narrow phrases, not blanket token removal, and apply to both ordinary terms and strong-profile phrases while raw official text and SHA-256 remain unchanged.
battle_type.strong_evidence_dedup_policy: Multiple phrases that restate the same semantic fact must not be stacked merely to inflate a type score; prefer one narrow direct phrase per fact.
battle_type.overlapping_token_policy: Within one battle type and one evidence field, longer matched terms consume their text before shorter nested terms are scored. A single occurrence such as 恐竜, 火炎, 猛毒, 深海, or 神聖 must not earn duplicate points through its shorter substring.
battle_type.direct_move_name_policy: An official special-move name may contribute battle-type evidence when the move name itself has a conventional, unambiguous elemental meaning; exact names such as ダイアモンドダスト are preferred over broad substring guesses.
battle_type.negation_and_reference_policy: Negated properties and references to other Digimon must not contribute positive type evidence. For example, '神聖な力なども一切持っていない' cannot trigger Fairy, and mentions of angel-type Digimon being observed, opposed, imitated, monitored, or consumed are not evidence that the subject itself is Fairy.
battle_type.move_name_false_positive_policy: Technique names that merely contain an elemental-looking token inside a fixed proper name or non-elemental compound are excluded when the official wording establishes a different semantic meaning; audited examples include 狐蝶幻, 胡蝶夢経, 突蜂, 蝶絶喇叭蹴, 葉隠, プロテクトウェーブ, ライアースロート, 臥龍扇, 愛の入魂金棒, ソウルフルコース, 断鉄剣, and 米鉄砲.

techniques.rule: Interpret each technique from official naming/description and the entity's official profile context. No fixed power/accuracy/PP fallback is authoritative.
techniques.direct_type_context_policy: A lone ordinary context-token hit below threshold does not directly resolve a technique type. Exact move-name evidence and explicit elemental/combat behavior may clear the threshold; otherwise use a resolved owner type only as fallback or leave the type placeholder unresolved.

gender_ratio.note: Explicit project gameplay rule; do not present as official Digimon/Appmon encyclopedia data.

profile_keyword_scoring.entity_name_policy: Exact self-name occurrences are masked from official profile prose before keyword scoring so substrings inside the entity name cannot be double-counted as profile semantics.
profile_keyword_scoring.raw_profile_preservation: The original official Japanese profile remains unchanged for SHA-256 lineage and source metadata; masking affects project gameplay interpretation only.
profile_keyword_scoring.threshold_policy: Do not lower the type-resolution threshold. Add strong phrases or official-type mappings only when the Japanese official text directly supports them.
